title: 第13章 王琳吃醋第14章 王艳的报复
content_zh:
王琳追过来，“叶开，这女的长的挺不错嘛，怎么认识你的？”
“她上山采药被人抓了，我救了她。”
“原来是英雄救美啊，我看她对你有意思。”
“你啥眼神，她是有钱人家的大小姐，怎么会看上我呢。”
王琳反问道：“你怎么知道她是有钱人家的？”
“你看看她开的车，只怕要几十万一辆吧？”
“嗯，你很有眼光嘛！不过也不一定哦，你看看她临走时候冲你笑的多甜，明显对你有意思。”
“拉倒吧，我所有的家当加起来，比不上人家一台车。”
“我看她身材很好，你刚才背着她什么感受，很舒服吧？”
“不舒服，累得很。”
“我不信，要是累，你能从山上把她背下来？”
“她崴了脚，不能走路啊。”
“我也崴脚了，不能走路，你也背我吧。”
叶开看了看王琳的脚，“你的脚好好的呀！”
王琳一咬牙，一跺脚，用力地扭了一下脚脖子，啊的娇呼一声。
她忍着痛对叶开说：“你看看，我的脚崴了没有？”
叶开一看，王琳的脚腕已经红肿了，自己走路肯定是不行了。
没想到这姑娘为了让叶开背她，竟不惜自残，真是任性。
叶开摇摇头，“你这是何苦呢？要是脚腕断了你就成残疾人了。”
王琳马尾辫一甩，“我才不管呢，残疾就残疾，我就要你背我。”

叶开蹲下来，握着王琳的脚，一拉一按，只听咔嚓一声，脚腕复位了。
叶开拍了拍手，“好啦，你现在可以走路了。”
王琳走了几步试了试，一点都不疼。
她很沮丧，这下没有理由让叶开背她了。
她吃惊地问：“怎么你随便按了一下，就好了呢？”
“这叫正骨术，可不是随便按的。”
“没想到你还会医术啊！”
“我会的多了。”
王琳挑逗道：“你还会些什么，撩妹会不会？”
叶开白了她一眼，“不会。”
“不会啊，我可以教你，来，我告诉你女孩子喜欢什么。”
“你歇歇吧，我还用你教，我要是想撩妹，分分钟的事。”
content_en:
Wang Lin chased after her, "Ye Kai, this girl is pretty good-looking. How do I know you?"
"She went up the mountain to collect medicine and was caught. I rescued her."
"It turns out that the hero saved the beauty. I think she is interested in you."
"What are you looking at? She is the eldest daughter of a rich family, how could she fall in love with me?"
Wang Lin asked, "How do you know she comes from a wealthy family?"
"Look at the car she drives. I'm afraid it costs hundreds of thousands, right?"
"Well, you are very discerning! But that's not necessarily true. Look at how sweet she smiled at you before leaving. She is obviously interested in you."
"Take it down. All my belongings put together are not as much as one person's car."
"I think she has a good figure. How did you feel when you were carrying her on your back? Was she comfortable?"
"Uncomfortable, very tired."
"I don't believe it. If you are tired, you can carry her down from the mountain?"
"She sprained her foot and can't walk."
"I also have a sprained foot and can't walk. You can carry me on your back."
Ye Kai looked at Wang Lin's feet and said, "Your feet are fine!"
Wang Lin gritted her teeth, stamped her feet, twisted her ankles vigorously, and let out a sweet cry.
She endured the pain and said to Ye Kai, "Look, are my feet sprained?"
Ye Kai took a look and saw that Wang Lin's ankles were red and swollen, and she would definitely be unable to walk on her own.
Unexpectedly, this girl would even harm herself in order to let Ye Kai carry her. She was so willful.
Ye Kai shook his head, "Why are you bothering? If your ankle is broken, you will become a disabled person."
Wang Lin flicked her ponytail and said, "I don't care. A disability is a disability. I want you to carry me."
Ye Kai squatted down, held Wang Lin's foot, pulled and pressed, and heard a click, and the ankle reset.
Ye Kai clapped his hands and said, "Okay, you can walk now."
Wang Lin took a few steps and tried it, but it didn't hurt at all.
She was very frustrated. There was no reason for Ye Kai to carry her now.
She asked in surprise: "How come you just pressed it and it was fine?"
"This is called bone-setting, and it's not just done casually."
"I didn't expect you to have medical skills!"
"I know a lot."
Wang Lin teased: "What else can you do? Is it okay to flirt with girls?"
Ye Kai rolled his eyes at her, "No."
"No, I can teach you. Come on, I'll tell you what girls like."
"You rest, I still need you to teach me. If I want to seduce a girl, it only takes a minute."
